# Fixture del host macOS: evaluateJavaScript con el código en una variable.
def applyTheme_(self, name):
    js = ("window.postMessage({source:'comandos',type:'theme',theme:"
          + json.dumps(name) + "},'*');")
    for t in self.tabs:
        t["webview"].evaluateJavaScript_completionHandler_(js, None)


ucc.addScriptMessageHandler_name_(self.bridge, "centro")
